title: Scheduling Parallel Optical Circuit Switches for AI Training
abstract: arXiv:2603.07373v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of AI training has dramatically increased datacenter traffic demand and energy consumption, which has motivated renewed interest in optical circuit switches (OCSes) as a high-bandwidth, energy-efficient alternative for AI fabrics. Deploying multiple parallel OCSes is a leading alternative. However, efficiently scheduling time-varying traffic matrices across parallel optical switches with non-negligible reconfiguration delays remains an open challenge.   We consider the problem of scheduling a single AI traffic demand matrix $D$ over $s$ parallel OCSes while minimizing the makespan under reconfiguration delay $\delta$. Our algorithm Spectra relies on a three-step approach: Decompose $D$ into a minimal set of weighted permutations; Schedule these permutations across parallel switches using load-aware assignment; then Equalize the imbalanced loads on the switches via controlled permutation splitting. Evaluated on

translated_title: 面向AI训练的并行光路交换机调度
translated_abstract: AI训练的快速增长极大地增加了数据中心的流量需求和能耗，这促使人们重新关注光路交换机（OCS）作为AI网络结构中高带宽、高能效的替代方案。部署多个并行OCS是一种主要的替代方案。然而，在具有不可忽略的重构延迟的并行光交换机之间高效调度时变流量矩阵，仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。我们考虑在重构延迟δ下，将单个AI流量需求矩阵 $D$ 调度到 $s$ 个并行OCS上并最小化完工时间的问题。我们的算法Spectra采用三步方法：将 $D$ 分解为最小化的加权置换集合；使用负载感知分配在并行交换机之间调度这些置换；然后通过受控的置换分裂来均衡交换机上不平衡的负载。（该算法已在……上进行了评估）
tldr: 提出Spectra算法，通过“分解为加权置换、负载感知分配调度、受控置换分裂均衡负载”三步方法，在存在重构延迟的情况下，将AI训练流量矩阵高效调度到多个并行光路交换机上以最小化完工时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Spectra, a three-step algorithm (weighted permutation decomposition, load-aware assignment, and controlled permutation splitting) that schedules AI training traffic matrices across parallel optical circuit switches to minimize makespan under reconfiguration delays.
